Enquire About Training

Technology training from Zeus

Alongside our technology services, Zeus System Technologies provides training that helps people use technology well. Whether you are starting with the basics or building specialist skills, we focus on practical learning you can apply.

We also work with organizations to train their teams on the tools and systems they use every day.

An overview of training areas. This page describes the areas we cover. It is not a published course catalogue, so dates and fees are not listed. Send an enquiry and we will talk through what is right for you.

Training areas

Eight areas, from first steps to specialist skills.

  • Computer fundamentals and digital literacy

    Getting comfortable with computers, files, the internet, and everyday digital tasks.

  • Operating systems and productivity tools

    Using operating systems and common office and productivity software with confidence.

  • IT support and troubleshooting

    Diagnosing and resolving common hardware, software, and user problems.

  • Networking fundamentals

    How networks work, and the basics of setting up and troubleshooting them.

  • Systems administration fundamentals

    The basics of managing users, systems, and servers.

  • Web development fundamentals

    An introduction to how websites are built.

  • Business technology and digital skills

    Using technology to work more effectively in a business setting.

  • Corporate and customized IT training

    Training shaped around your organization’s tools, teams, and goals.

Delivery formats

Learn in the way that suits you.

  • Instructor-led classroom training

    In-person sessions led by an instructor, with the chance to ask questions and practise.

  • Virtual training

    Live sessions delivered online, so learners can take part from where they are.

  • Corporate or customized sessions

    Sessions arranged for your team and your requirements.

    Subject to availability.

Training process

From your first enquiry to feedback after delivery.

  1. 1

    Enquiry

    You tell us what you or your team want to learn.

  2. 2

    Needs assessment

    We discuss current skills, goals, and constraints.

  3. 3

    Recommended course

    We recommend training areas and a format that fit.

  4. 4

    Scheduling

    We agree timing and arrangements with you.

  5. 5

    Delivery

    The training takes place in the agreed format.

  6. 6

    Feedback

    We ask for your feedback to improve what follows.

Who training is for

People and organizations at every stage.

  • Individuals

    People building everyday digital skills or exploring a technology interest.

  • Students

    Learners who want practical skills alongside their studies.

  • Professionals

    Working people who want to use technology more effectively or broaden their skills.

  • Organizations

    Teams and institutions that want their people trained on the tools they use.

Frequently asked questions

What courses do you offer?

This page gives an overview of the training areas we cover. We do not publish a fixed course catalogue, so tell us what you want to learn and we will recommend training that fits.

When do courses start, and how much do they cost?

We do not publish course dates or fees online. Send an enquiry and we will discuss schedules and costs with you.

Will I receive a certificate or professional certification?

We do not advertise accredited certifications. If a certificate of attendance or any other recognition matters to you, ask when you enquire and we will tell you what is available.

Can you train my team at our workplace?

Corporate and customized sessions are available subject to availability. Describe your team and what they need to learn, and we will discuss the options.

I am a beginner. Where should I start?

Computer fundamentals and digital literacy is a good starting point for many people. Tell us your current level and goals, and we will suggest where to begin.

Do you offer online training?

Yes, virtual training is one of our delivery formats. Tell us your preference in the enquiry form.
